items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: Now when you write to Louis, tell Louis harder for me. ... Tell Louis I still, tell Louis I still, tell him that I ain't behind the whoop parade, but I still like to see him back here.

ctx.x: Franklin and Gravy. Yeah. You remember, you say you remember Rabbit, huh? Yeah, I remember Rabbit.

Do you remember what he used to sing? I forgot, I forgot not what he used to sing. I know he used to, yeah, I forgot what he used to sing, no. He had some song about that who killed the chief business. What's he? I forgot what kind of song he used to sing so many songs to that day too, that I didn't know what. Half of the time I didn't know what he was singing. Sometime I used to catch Rabbit. Say Rabbit, he say what? Say, you all playing tonight? Say, yeah, man, we playing in such and such a place. Say, alright.…
